subject: general
question: Karuna reads (1)/(4)th of a book in one hour. What fraction of the book will she be able to read in 2 h 15 min?
solution:
**Given:**

Karuna reads (1)/(4) of a book in one hour.

**Formula Used:**

Fraction read = (Reading speed) × (Time)

**Calculation:**

Reading speed = (1)/(4)
